caption: Bina kisi editing software ke, Claude se aise motion graphics videos banao. Poora setup, start se end tak.
Step one. GitHub par ek repo banao, aur use Claude Code mein connect karo. Phir bas bolo, setup chalao.
Setup khud sab install karta hai. Remotion animation ke liye, Whisper captions ke liye, free AI voice, aur SFX.
Step two. Reference video, apni A-roll, aur voice over, inko apne-apne folders mein daalo.
Step three. Claude reference ko frame by frame analyse karta hai, aur uska style aur topic samajhta hai.
Phir woh script likhta hai, AI voice banata hai, aur Remotion mein har scene animate karta hai.
Last mein SFX aur music ke saath, 1080p mein final render. Sirf baarah minute mein.
Aur sabse best baat? Ye cloud mein bhi chalta hai, aur naye session mein setup apne aap ho jata hai.
Aise hi AI video editing seekhni hai, toh follow kar lo.
